upstream.source_data: Raw Avazu CTR impression dataset (Data/train.gz, 40.4M impressions, 24 attributes).
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: None (Pipeline Genesis). Initial empirical prior: binary target y in {0, 1} with class imbalance.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Direct full-file disk reads of 40.4M rows cause severe memory exhaustion (>12GB RAM). Stratified systematic sampling with memory downcasting preserves global distribution properties while operating within laptop and edge constraints.
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N) \quad\text{Space: Downcast from } 1.2\text{GB} \to 182.2\text{MB } (84.8\%\text{ reduction via uint32/category pointers})

downstream.hand_off_contract: Provides verified schema with 0 missing values, fixed random seed (42), and consistent 1,010,000 impression sample.

adtech_role.system_component: DSP Ingestion Pipeline & Log Stream Consumer
adtech_role.business_impact: Establishes stream ingestion throughput benchmarks and global baseline prior probability for cold-start bidding in Real-Time Bidding (RTB) exchanges.
